title: Long-bar quenching across a 6 m working width
summary: Suneng’s fork-handling furnace carries long bars parallel to the furnace door. A charging car lifts the complete batch between the hearth supports. The agreement permits no more than 30 seconds from first outward movement to full immersion with 5 tonnes of workpieces.
seoTitle: Long bars: fork handling and a 30-second quench transfer
seoDescription: The 2023 agreement times a 5-tonne load from its first outward movement to full immersion. See the 6 m working width and 30-second limit.

forkReview.note: The bars run parallel to the door. The working width also includes clearance at both ends.
features: A wide doorway for transverse loading
The bars rest across the supports parallel to the door along the 6 m working width. The forks enter between the supports and lift the batch together.
Quenching the entire batch outside the furnace
After the door opens, the rail-mounted car lifts the bars out, moves them to the tank and lowers them. The bars retain their transverse orientation.

stages.title: Charge across the door
stages.note: Lay the long bars on the supports parallel to the door across the 6 m working width.

stages.title: Lift on the forks
stages.note: Insert the forks between the supports and lift the complete batch.

stages.title: Withdraw the batch
stages.note: Once the door is fully open, start timing at the first outward movement.

stages.title: Fully immerse the bars
stages.note: Keep the transverse arrangement. Stop timing when the last bar is fully submerged.

cards.title: Supply responsibilities
definitions: Provides foundation construction information, installs and commissions the equipment, and trains operators.
Supplies the water-quench tank and heat-resistant steel basket, prepares the installation site to the foundation drawing and assists with water, electricity, gas and lifting equipment.

cards.title: Scope of supply
paragraphs: Suneng supplies the resistance-heated chamber furnace, door and lift, rail-mounted fork car and electrical controls. The furnace heats in zones. The car lifts and transfers the entire batch.

cards.title: Acceptance procedure
definitions: After manufacture, the agreement calls for the buyer to inspect assembly quality, safety items and associated equipment at the factory.
Cold commissioning precedes heating under load. The acceptance criterion is compliance with the contract’s technical requirements.

figure.caption: Lay the bars parallel to the furnace door. With the door fully open, start when the batch first moves out. The last bar is fully submerged. Agreement: a maximum of 30 s for 5 tonnes of workpieces.

forkReview.faqIntro: Working width, timing full immersion and responsibility for the tank.
faq: Is 6 m the chamber depth or the width along the door?
It is the working width along the door. The working depth is 1.3 m and the working height is 0.6 m. The bars lie across the width.
What do the 5 tonnes and 30 seconds refer to?
The 5 tonnes is workpiece weight excluding the support blocks. With the door fully open, time from first outward movement until the complete batch is submerged.
Who supplies the quench tank and handling equipment?
The buyer supplies the tank. Suneng supplies the rail-mounted fork car. The interfaces include the tank opening, track and clearance for lowering the forks.
